title: The page's item checks refuse at publish, not only in the owner's browser
why: Owner, 13:58 CST Nov 6 (thread 53e2d6e5): the picture check flagged item 292 in his browser, but nothing stopped it at publish, so he had to push it back.
note:
Cause: pictureProblem and the other item checks live only in skills/waiting-page/page.html and run when the page draws. export_page.py and the publish path run none of them.
Fix: one home for the checks, run by the export or publish step, which refuses with the same message. Test: red on item 292's bad focus.
Source: owner thread 53e2d6e5, 13:58 CST; asked the coordinator for a lane at 14:01 CST. Unknown check (triage 15:27 CST Nov 6, from item 276 a, owner 12:39 CST: one rule, a check that cannot read its input fails): export_page.py --check holds the republish on 'checks unknown' (option B). Not paged. Measured: the page's only writer, triage in the cloud, has node 22, Playwright and Chromium 1243, so the hold costs nothing there.
